definitions.full: H2852. chathak [ חָתַךְ ] verb divide, determine (Late Hebrew id., cut, cut off, decide , so Aramaic חתך Pa`el, Ethpa`al) — only Niph`al Perfect עַלעַֿמְּךָ נֶחְתַּךְ שִׁבְעִים שָֽׁבֻעִים Dan 9:24 seventy weeks are determined upon thy people.
